overview_description.description:
Materialize is a streaming SQL database company that makes it easy for developers to understand streaming data, answer complex questions, and build intelligent applications using standard technology. Materialize allows users to ask questions about their data, and then get low-latency results even as the underlying data changes and keeps the results of the queries and incrementally updates them as new data comes in.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York.

product.name: Materialize Streaming SQL Database
product.description: A streaming SQL database that maintains real-time, incrementally updated materialized views for complex queries on live data streams.

product.name: Materialize Self-Managed Enterprise Edition
product.description: A version of Materialize that can be deployed and managed within a customer's own cloud or private infrastructure for greater control and compliance.

product.name: Materialize Managed Cloud
product.description: A fully managed SaaS offering of Materialize providing real-time data integration and transformation with automated upgrades and scalability.

product.name: Materialize Emulator
product.description: A local development environment packaged as a Docker image for experimenting with Materialize's streaming SQL capabilities.

product.name: Materialize SQL Subscriptions
product.description: A feature that allows users to subscribe to SQL query results and receive real-time notifications when data changes meet specified criteria.
